workflow: Explain prerequisites in simple Telugu with English technical terms and useful tables
Review original MCQs in separate complete Telugu and English with explanations and exact note links
Read assigned source pages in printed order; record every factual subclaim, concept and printed PYQ in the same reading pass
Verify unclear facts with suitable primary evidence; integrate additions and corrections into main notes
Map each assessable item to a specific MCQ stem and keyed choice; explanation-only mentions are not coverage
Add purposeful APPSC-style recall, matching, statements, conceptual applications and calculations; tag Easy, Moderate or Hard
Keep uncertain source claims and unverified historical imports unscored; preserve original question wording and all source/answer evidence
Run focused drafting checks, then full chapter acceptance tests after content settles; retain a visible completion checklist

difficulty.easy: Direct definition, identification or one factual relationship
difficulty.moderate: Comparison, matching, two statements, simple scenario or short calculation
difficulty.hard: Combined concepts, exceptions, misconception diagnosis, data interpretation or multi-step calculation
difficulty.policy: Editorial reasoning-demand labels, not official difficulty ratings. Do not manufacture difficulty from verbosity or obscure trivia. No fixed question quota; direct fact coverage precedes integrated combinations.

printed_pyq_policy.missing_data: null / not stated. Never invent options, exam stage, year or official key.
printed_pyq_policy.provenance: Preserve raw printed wording and answer; translations and explanatory corrections are separate fields. Book attribution is not original-paper verification.
printed_pyq_policy.tg: Display TG, actual board label, exam and year. TS-SI/Constable must not automatically be classified as TGPSC. Verify the recruiting body.
printed_pyq_policy.duplicates: Review against existing PYQs and other book appearances; retain each distinct exam appearance.
printed_pyq_policy.scoring: Historical imports remain unscored until paper identity, wording and official-final-key requirements are met.

efficiency: One chapter in progress at a time
Reuse approved notes and question banks; do not regenerate finished material
Capture page facts and printed PYQs together
Reuse one fact ledger for notes, assessments and coverage reports
Targeted checks during drafting; full chapter tests once stable; shared regression at milestones
Do not force unrepresented continent/biome/ocean topics into unrelated chapters; record a source-backed expansion decision
completion_gate: Notes integrated, every printed claim accounted for, assessable facts tested, bilingual explanations/anchors checked, difficulty reviewed, printed PYQs extracted or explicitly unresolved, and tests passed. Baseline existence alone is not completion.
